name: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana
summary: A small savings scheme for a girl child below 10 years of age, offering an attractive fixed interest rate and a tax-free maturity amount that can be used for her education or marriage.

eligibility_clauses.text: The account must be opened for a girl child.
The girl child must be below 10 years of age at the time of opening the account.

entitlement_rules.text: A minimum deposit of Rs. 250 per year earns the notified rate of interest and the maturity proceeds are fully tax-free.

appeal_hierarchy.description: First grievance at the account office.
